# Employment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Employment`](gmeow-Employment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Employment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/employment`](../../slices/employment.md)

A reified employment relationship between an agent and an organization, optionally founded on an employment contract and bearing a role, compensation, and employment type over a period. A specialization of [`gmeow:Membership`](gmeow-Membership.md): the employment-specific facets (compensation, seniority, employment type) are added here; the structural spine (member, organization, role, period) is inherited.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Membership`](gmeow-Membership.md)

Use [`gmeow:Employment`](gmeow-Employment.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Membership`](gmeow-Membership.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
